structs.name: ABFence
structs.size_evidence: not proven. Replay has no allocation, clear or stride for ABFence. Its vtable (3 slots at 0x1423EC648: FenceObject::UpdateDependencies 0x140F19C70, FenceObject_GetFenceValue 0x140F19C50, ABFence::UpdateIsPassingInternal 0x140F19EE0 via the .rdata offset xref at 0x1423EC658) has no code xref to its start, so no constructor or static instance was found. IDA 112 and game-test 80 are both unproven. Lower bound: the Replay accesses end at +13 (14 bytes); the vtable shows a FenceObject-derived class. Upper bound: none found.
members: ABFence::vtable@0x1423EC648: slots 0 and 1 are FenceObject's own functions (0x140F19C70, 0x140F19C50); ABFence derives FenceObject (80 in game-test, base layout of FenceObject in IDA). UNCONFIRMED as a size, CONFIRMED as the derivation.

ABFence::UpdateIsPassingInternal@0x140F19EE0: `*(int *)(this+8)` is the index added to the Online_AB_Testing::GetInstance() result (CONFIRMED). Game-test names offset 8 in the FenceObject base as m_controllerIndex (int); the name m_mode is an IDA guess. Proposed rename to m_controllerIndex, UNCONFIRMED semantics, not applied.
ABFence::UpdateIsPassingInternal@0x140F19EE0: `*(BYTE *)(this+13) = (AB[index+64] != 0) || (AB[index+65] != 0)` (CONFIRMED). Game-test name at 13 is FenceObject::m_isPassing (bool): names agree.
changed_members: char[40] at 64 lies inside the FenceObject base (0..80): remove or move past the base
no Replay access at 64 by ABFence; the 64/65 bytes read by UpdateIsPassingInternal belong to Online_AB_Testing, not ABFence
char[8] at 104: past the base, no Replay evidence
unconfirmed: m_embedded64 (40 bytes at 64) and m_embedded104 (8 bytes at 104): no Replay access; remove or keep only if the base size is proven larger
_padE (50 bytes at 14) is FenceObject base content (m_failed, m_errorCode, m_fenceDependencies, m_callbacks) in game-test, not ABFence
structs.notes: Confirmed: offsets 8 and 13 (the only Replay accesses). The FenceObject base of 80 is the game-test value and matches Replay's static FenceObject objects in FenceObjects_Init (stride 0x50, writes at +8, +0x18, +0x20). ABFence's own size stays open because no ABFence instance is allocated or stored in Replay code.

structs.name: ASM_Context
structs.size_evidence: no Replay evidence for the name. Checked: names (no ASM_Context / asm_context symbol), strings (no 'ASM_Context' text), types (every Replay prototype that takes a context uses `struct PlayerASM_Context *` instead: PlayerASM_DoFootNotetrack@0x140C98380, WorldUpMp_GetStoredGroundUpIfSupported@0x140D2A2A0, CG_IsDualWielding@0x1411395A0; no prototype uses plain ASM_Context). The Common_Asm, BgPlayer_Asm and Ai_Asm names do not use it. Game-test ASM_Context is a 1-byte stub with 0 fields.
unconfirmed: _pad0, flagByte17, _pad12, ptr24, _pad20, sub136, sub192: no Replay access (the IDA placeholders have no evidence)
structs.notes: Absent in this build under this name. Replay's per-player animation context is PlayerASM_Context (IDA 440 bytes; game-test 440; its members ps/const_ps/useEntityState/disableCache/playerAsm/holdrand/instances are touched by PlayerASM_DoFootNotetrack through a2->pAsm and a1). That struct is not in this entry and was not checked. ASM_Context's IDA layout (200 bytes, ptr24, flagByte17, sub136) is an unsupported placeholder and should be removed by the coordinator. Not checked: whole-binary allocation scan for a 200-byte object (the name-based and type-based checks found nothing).

structs.name: pooledStorageWriteFileInfo
structs.size_evidence: not proven. Game-test 16760 and builder 16784 are both unproven. Replay's bdPooledStorage upload functions (_preUpload@0x14213D390, _preUploadMultiPart@0x14213D580, _postUploadFile@0x14213CEA0, uploadSummaryMetaData@0x14213D7D0) and DWPooledStorage::uploadSummaryMetaData@0x140F784F0 use bdPooledStorage's own fields (a1+22434, a1+23588, a1+84600, a1+84656, a1+84664, a1+84728, a1+84736, 1200-byte per-entry records at a1+11354). None reads or writes a pooledStorageWriteFileInfo member. A scan of 0x14213CE00-0x14213DA00 and 0x140F71000-0x140F79000 for 4178h/4190h (16760/16784) found no match.
unconfirmed: all 12 members (m_fileData .. m_failureCallback): no Replay access found
structs.notes: The only Replay code that could hold this object is the AnalyticsStream upload path (AnalyticsBuffer 16784 in IDA, with this struct at +16). Its functions are unnamed in Replay (only .xdata unwind names $unwind$AnalyticsStream__EndStream / __ResetBuffer exist; the function starts were not resolved from .pdata), so their bodies were NOT read. Verdict stays partial until those bodies are read for a 16760/16784 allocation or a member offset. Game-test function users (AnalyticsStream::ResetPooledStorageWriteInfo, PooledStorage_FileManager_UploadFile) have no Replay names.
